# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the EMA ribbon contracts (squeeze), a breakout with above-average volume signals the start of a short-term trend. Entering long on the breakout bar close captures the initial momentum of the trend.

## Mechanism

Compute 9-, 20-, and 50-period EMAs on 5‑min bars. Define ribbon squeeze when (max(EMA) - min(EMA)) < 0.1 × ATR(14) for three consecutive bars. On the next bar, if close > max(EMA) and volume > 1.3 × average volume of the prior five bars, enter long at that bar’s close. Exit: chart‑stop at the lowest EMA of the squeeze period, TP1 at 2× risk, runner using a chandelier trail (ATR×3). Regime filters: only take if price > 200‑period EMA (higher timeframe) and VIX between 15‑25; avoid when price < 200‑EMA.
